winnebago.definition:
n. a member of the Siouan-speaking people formerly living in eastern Wisconsin south of Green Bay; ally of the Menomini and enemy of the Fox and Sauk people
n. the Siouan language spoken by the Winnebago
winnebago.translation: n. 美国温尼贝戈族印第安人；温尼贝戈语

winnebagoes.definition:
n. A tribe of North American Indians who originally
   occupied the region about Green Bay, Lake Michigan, but were driven
   back from the lake and nearly exterminated in 1640 by the IIlinnois.
winnebagoes.translation: n. 美国温尼贝戈族印第安人；温尼贝戈语

winner.definition:
n. the contestant who wins the contest
n. a gambler who wins a bet
winner.translation:
n. 胜利者, 优胜者
[法] 取胜者

winner's circle.translation: [赛马]优胜者(指马、骑手和马主)与观众见面的绕场圈；授奖区

winner-take-all.translation: 胜者为王; 赢者通吃

winners.definition:
n the contestant who wins the contest
n a gambler who wins a bet
n a person with a record of successes

winnett.translation: [人名] 温尼特; [地名] [美国] 温纳特

winnie.translation: n. 维尼（迪斯尼卡通角色名）；温妮（人名）

winnie-the-pooh.translation: 小熊维尼（一卡通片名称）

winning.translation:
n. 胜利, 获得, 成功, 赢得物
a. 得胜的, 胜利的

winning post.translation: n. 跑道上指示终点的竿

winning streak.translation: n. 连胜场数，连胜纪录; [体]一连串的胜利

winningest.definition:
s having won
s very attractive; capturing interest

winningness.definition: n. The quality or state of being winning.

winnipeg.definition:
n. the capital and largest city of Manitoba; located in southern Manitoba; known for severe winters
n. a lake in southern Canada in Manitoba
winnipeg.translation: n. 温尼伯（加拿大城市）

winnipeg, lake.translation: 温尼泊湖(加拿大曼尼托巴省大湖)

winnipegger.translation: 温尼泊(加拿大曼尼托巴省省会)；温尼泊河(加拿大南部河流)

winnipesaukee.translation: n. 温尼帕索基湖，新罕布什尔州

winnow.definition:
n. the act of separating grain from chaff
v. separate the chaff from by using air currents
v. blow on
winnow.translation:
vt. 簸, 扬(谷), 吹掉, 把挑出来, 精选
vi. 扬谷, 分出好坏, 飞翔
n. 扬谷, 扬谷器

winnowed.translation:
a. 扬净的, 风选的
v. 扬( winnow的过去式和过去分词 ); 辨别; 选择; 除去

winnower.definition:
n. One who, or that which, winnows; specifically, a
   winnowing machine.
winnower.translation: n. 扬场者, 扬谷器, 风车

winnowing.definition:
n the act of separating grain from chaff
v separate the chaff from by using air currents
v blow on
v select desirable parts from a group or list
v blow away or off with a current of air
winnowing.translation: v. 扬( winnow的现在分词 ); 辨别; 选择; 除去

winnows.definition:
n the act of separating grain from chaff
v separate the chaff from by using air currents
v blow on
v select desirable parts from a group or list
v blow away or off with a current of air
winnows.translation: v. 扬( winnow的第三人称单数 ); 辨别; 选择; 除去
